Role: Senior Software Engineer, DGX Cloud AI Infrastructure
Location: Hybrid, Seattle, WA
Level: Senior

Requirements:
- 8+ years in software engineering, systems engineering, or infrastructure
- 3+ years Kubernetes (cluster lifecycle, operator patterns, CRDs, admission controllers)
- Deep understanding of compute orchestration for AI/ML (GPU scheduling, multi-tenant isolation, job lifecycle)
- Go or Python (production-grade infrastructure tooling)
- Cloud-native patterns (microservices, service mesh, event-driven architectures)
- Linux systems internals (kernel, cgroups, namespaces, networking)

Preferred:
- NVIDIA GPU stack (drivers, CUDA, NCCL, DCGM, MIG)
- Bare-metal provisioning (PXE, IPMI/BMC, firmware management)
- Networking for HPC/AI (InfiniBand, RoCE, GPUDirect RDMA)
- Slurm, Ray, or similar HPC schedulers
- Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects

Responsibilities:
- Build and operate DGX Cloud infrastructure at scale
- Kubernetes-based GPU cluster management
- Bare-metal and network automation
- Observability and reliability for AI workloads
